# swarmops ls

List one directory at a revision (the root without a PATH), and with --depth the directories below it.

```yaml
title: "swarmops ls"
description: "List one directory at a revision (the root without a PATH), and with --depth the directories below it."
group: "read"
since: "0.1.0"
mutates: false
identity_required: false
mcp_tool: "read_tree"
envelope_op: "read_tree"
exit_codes: [0]
errors: []
syntax: "swarmops ls [OPTIONS] <REV[:PATH]>"
```

## Syntax

```text
swarmops ls [OPTIONS] <REV[:PATH]>
```

## Required arguments

### `REV[:PATH]`

Syntax: `<REV[:PATH]>`.

The revision, and the directory's path after the first ':'.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

### `--depth`

Syntax: `--depth <N>`.
Default: `1`.

How many levels to list: 1 for the directory's own entries, 2 for theirs too, and so on, up to 64.

### `--limit`

Syntax: `--limit <N>`.
Default: `250`.

The most entries to list.

### `--cursor`

Syntax: `--cursor <CURSOR>`.

Resume a listing: the previous page's cursor, exactly as it was returned.

## Examples

### CLI

```sh
swarmops --repo [tmp]/store ls main
```

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "op": "read_tree",
  "api": 1,
  "result": {
    "entries": [
      {
        "name": "README.md",
        "kind": "file",
        "size": 18,
        "id": "[id1]"
      },
      {
        "name": "bin",
        "kind": "dir",
        "id": "[id6]"
      },
      {
        "name": "latest",
        "kind": "symlink",
        "size": 9,
        "id": "[id4]"
      },
      {
        "name": "logo.bin",
        "kind": "file",
        "size": 4,
        "id": "[id2]"
      },
      {
        "name": "src",
        "kind": "dir",
        "id": "[id7]"
      }
    ],
    "truncated": false
  },
  "meta": {
    "repo": "[tmp]/store",
    "elapsed_ms": "[elapsed_ms]",
    "resolved": {
      "main": "[c2]"
    },
    "auth": "trust"
  }
}
```

Exit code 0. Recorded by the CLI tests. A name in square brackets, such as `[tmp]` or `[c1]`, stands for what differs from run to run: the test's temporary directory, an id, a time.

### MCP

No recorded example yet.

## Return information

`result` is a `TreeListing` (`swarmops schema TreeListing` prints its JSON Schema).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | `string or null` | no | When `truncated`: where the next page starts. Opaque: pass it back as given, as the next request's `cursor`. |
| `entries` | `array of TreeEntryOut` | yes | The entries. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | yes | Whether more entries follow this page. |

Envelope `op`: `read_tree`.

Exit codes:

- `0`: Success.

## Errors

No golden step shows this command failing yet.

Any command that opens a store may also fail with a store error, such as [`E_NOT_A_REPO`](../errors.md#e_not_a_repo), [`E_IO`](../errors.md#e_io) or [`E_STORE_CORRUPT`](../errors.md#e_store_corrupt); a command line the grammar refuses is [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg) (exit 2).
